links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4o patient education materials versus AAPOS materials (QGLOP accuracy subscale)
links.effect: AAPOS accuracy 4.0 ± 0 vs English ChatGPT 2.79 ± 0.79, P = .0021; currency 3.79 vs 3.38, P = .033; tone 4.0 vs 3.42, P = .042.
links.quote: Based on average scores from the four procedures, AAPOS PEMs were superior to English Chat-GPT responses on the accuracy, currency, and tone subscales of the QGLOP score (4.0 ± 0 vs 2.79 ± 0.79, P = .0021; 3.79 ± 0.26 vs 3.38 ± 0.71, P = .033; 4.0 ± 0 vs 3.42 ± 0.69, P = .042, respectively).

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4o patient education materials at requested 6th grade level versus AAPOS
links.effect: No significant difference in readability between AAPOS PEMs and English ChatGPT responses; English and Spanish ChatGPT did not differ on readability.
links.quote: There was no significant difference in readability between AAPOS PEMs and English ChatGPT responses.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality and readability of ChatGPT-4o-generated pediatric ophthalmologic patient educational materials against professional society standards (AAPOS) without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
